objective: Image-driven multi-view surface reconstruction: VGGT-Omega supplies coarse cameras, scale, silhouette and initial geometry only; differentiable rendering of the original RGB optimises the surface, with material/lighting factored for glossy scenes. VGGT depth is initialisation, not a supervision target.

revision.summary: Main line changed from VGGT depth/normal correction to image-driven surface reconstruction on a VGGT-initialised coarse geometry.
revision.history_status: phase1 retained; phases P2-P6 and the phase3 ladder marked superseded

hardware.resource_policy: long runs in tmux with logs on disk; do not kill other users' jobs; prefer microbatch/resolution reduction before deep tuning

URGT / HyDen priors (main line or appendix)

arms.B0: raw VGGT depth/confidence -> train-only Sim(3) -> TSDF uniform weights, nearest sampling, no filter, no carving (no GT)
arms.B1: consistency_filter (no masks, tau_abs=1% camera span, tau_rel=0.05, min_agree=2, no confidence cut) -> confidence-weighted TSDF, nearest (no GT)
arms.B1_legacy: Lego v35c30 free-space carving with GT foreground masks + confidence fusion; diagnostic only, GT-assisted, excluded from cross-scene gates

metrics.evaluator: scripts/eval_point_metrics.py (implemented and synthetically self-tested 2026-11-04: offset 0.01 -> chamfer 0.010715; Sim(3) scale 1.3 recovered as 1.3000000000000005)
metrics.alignment: train-only Sim(3) from predicted camera centres to GT camera centres; scale applied to depth and mesh; no per-view scale/shift
metrics.sampling: 50k fixed-seed area-weighted mesh samples; 50k fixed-seed GT samples
metrics.accuracy: mean nearest distance mesh samples -> GT point set
metrics.completeness: mean nearest distance GT samples -> mesh samples
metrics.chamfer: symmetric mean of accuracy and completeness
metrics.fscore: F1 at 1 P0 voxel and F2 at 2 voxels
metrics.threshold_units: Lego uses the P0 voxel directly (GT gauge); ETH3D uses P0 voxel x Sim(3) scale and records scale in surface_metrics.json
metrics.lego_secondary: Blender measure_surfaces triangle-exact metrics and normal error for phase-1 continuity
metrics.output: outputs/72h/<scene>_<arm>/surface_metrics.json with grid and GT sample hashes

plan_2026_11_05.goal: Recover accurate surfaces from multi-view RGB by differentiable rendering, starting from VGGT-Omega coarse geometry; VGGT is initialisation, not supervision.
removed_from_all_plans: VGGT depth/normal as a supervision target

stage1_surface_recovery.loss: lambda_s silhouette + lambda_c correspondence + lambda_r render + lambda_g geometry
stage1_surface_recovery.topology: allowed; wrong triangles may be removed and rebuilt

stage2_explicit_refinement.forbidden: strong VGGT depth loss (would pull the corrected geometry back)

stages.appearance: Factored-NeuS-style material/lighting decomposition for glossy objects; otherwise the RGB loss explains geometry error away

step0_objective_validity.0a_appearance_fit: fix GT Mesh and VGGT Mesh separately, optimise constrained appearance only on 16 train views, evaluate on 4 heldout; the GT mesh must render clearly better on heldout
step0_objective_validity.0b_known_perturbation: perturb the GT mesh by +/-0.5/1/2 voxel along normals, smoothing and hole filling, then optimise geometry; gradient direction agreement >=80% with monotone error decrease
step0_objective_validity.0c_gloss_diagnostic: if highlight regions give reversed gradients the appearance model fails; material/lighting decomposition is then mandatory
step0_objective_validity.gate: A/B/C do not start until 0a and 0b pass; thresholds are frozen after Step 0

0a.rule: GT-mesh held-out PSNR exceeds VGGT-mesh by >= 1 dB

0b.rule: vertex gradient direction restores the perturbation toward the reference in >= 80% of cases

0c.note: no systematic reversal, but close to chance

step0_1_diagnostics.note: New separate test; the Step 0 80% NO-GO result and numbers are preserved unchanged

code_fixes.local_deformation: V_i(a) = V_i^0 + a*w_i*n_i with a sigma=4 voxel Gaussian bump; per-vertex direction ratio retired
code_fixes.finite_difference: central difference h=0.2 voxel against autograd for scalar a
code_fixes.curvature_mask: normalised by the actual number of incident faces instead of dividing by 3
code_fixes.photometric_loss: optional symmetric silhouette term |alpha - GT mask| over the full image; Step 0 foreground-only loss is not comparable

level2_supervision_effectiveness.note: silhouette-only is a coverage-bound diagnostic, not a veto

decision.label: proxy 0-step normal, 100-step degrades -> objective / regularisation / parameterisation

decision.next: separate RGB / silhouette / colour-field degrees of freedom (freeze colour, RGB-off, smaller colour grid / no specular) before further sign-field work

step_ablation_20261105.purpose: split area inflation and Chamfer degradation into RGB / silhouette / correspondence / colour-field degrees of freedom after #12.10 ruled out grid resolution

code_changes.albedo: grid: learnable 64^3 albedo (786,432 params); lowrank: CP factorisation over x/y/z (rank 16 ~3,120, rank 4 ~780); fixed: frozen 0.5 grey, only SH/lighting optimised
code_changes.defaults_unchanged: rgb 1.0 / sil 0.5 / corr 0.02 / grid albedo, so #12.9 proxy_e100 stays reproducible

step_ablation_20261105.area_caliber: area_true_m2 = 0.5 * sum|cross| (real triangle area); #12.9 and #12.10 tables used sum|cross| (2x). Ratios are unaffected

fixed_albedo.confound: albedo frozen at 0.5 grey, so the photometric target is unreachable; proves colour-failure shifts load to geometry, not that fewer DOFs must inflate

region_split.definition: output face centroid -> nearest input surface; opening = nearest point on an input open boundary (sign unreliable); near <=3 vox, mid 3-10 vox, far >10 vox

ranking: RGB photometric (+1.636x of the +1.374x full area increment; 119%)
colour-field degrees of freedom (inverse: fewer DOFs inflate more, +2.037x to +3.165x)
silhouette (+0.060x, 4%; loss 0.0038->0.0019 but geometry barely moves)
decision.verdict: the RGB term alone drives the inflation; colour freedom is protective, not causative
decision.conflict: RGB is the only term that produces usable appearance and the only term that inflates; sil_only/corr_only reach F1 0.78 / sharp P 0.74 but their colour field is never supervised (PSNR ~11 dB), so dropping RGB is not a usable configuration
decision.step_curve: area grows monotonically with steps (full 1.944 -> 2.790 -> 2.967 -> 3.318); 25 steps already reach 80-84% of the 100-step value; F1 peaks at 50 steps
decision.next: scan intermediate --rgb-weight (0.1/0.25/0.5) and --color-res (16^3/32^3) to look for a trade-off; do not return to grid resolution or initialisation

caliber_notes.area: #12.9/#12.10 used sum|cross| = 2x true area; this section uses 0.5*sum|cross|. Absolute m2 halved, ratios unchanged, old numbers untouched
caliber_notes.components: #12.9 component counts (proxy_e0=4, proxy_e100=2) came from init2x2_stats.py using index//3 over a 3N-row stack, which mislabels faces and over-merges; corrected edge-adjacency gives 660 and 1438. Every run here still has exactly one component >=1% of the faces (largest 92-94%)

queue_and_gpu.note: the texture line held .locks/gpu4090.lock while itself waiting for >=10000 MiB free that never arrived (free stayed at 7043 MiB); no process was killed and no job ran concurrently. After the lock was taken, every run re-checked free >=6300 MiB and released the lock immediately if the card was busy

step_ablation_20261105.invalid_runs: none; all 11 runs exited 0 and produced mesh.ply

step_sweep_20261105.purpose: locate the knee between area inflation and appearance after the supervision ablation; do not touch grid resolution or initialisation
step_sweep_20261105.base_config: proxy Mesh e4006a146e8ae5d6, grid-res 160, render 256, 16 GT cameras, 64^3 albedo + SH, dev 0.1, seed 20261105, 100 iters, corr file outputs/step_init_20261105/proxy_e100/correspondence.npz

axes.rule: each axis swept alone first; the 2x2 cross was only run after a knee appeared (0.02)

region_split.definition: same as step_ablation_20261105: nearest input surface; opening = nearest point on an input open boundary; near <=3 vox, mid 3-10 vox, far >10 vox

cross_2x2.verdict: additive main effects, no interaction; the knee holds at both colour resolutions

decision.no_knee_on_color_res: 16^3 -> 32^3 -> 64^3 improves both geometry and appearance; compressing colour resolution is a double loss
decision.cliff: rgb_weight 0.005 -> 0: area returns to 1.944x but heldout PSNR collapses to 11.41 (colour field unsupervised); this is failure, not a trade-off
decision.no_tradeoff_statement: rejected: a knee exists at rgb_weight 0.02; the conflict is single-peaked, not monotone opposition

root_cause.primary: missing geometry-side regularisation (no surface area / curvature / normal-consistency term; L_dev only penalises offset magnitude)
root_cause.amplifier: rgb 1.0 vs sil 0.5 lets the RGB residual dominate the total loss
root_cause.secondary: colour-field capacity (64^3 albedo + SH) cannot explain specular/high-frequency residual, so the residual is pushed onto geometry
root_cause.status: interpretation supported by 12 cells, not proven; a surface-area/curvature regulariser or patch-based photometric term is needed to falsify

queue_and_gpu.lock_policy: flock -n -> check free >= 6300 MiB -> release immediately if short -> retry every 3 s
queue_and_gpu.lock_acquired: all 10 runs LOCK_OK waited=0s free=7895 MiB
queue_and_gpu.note: the texture line is still polling for 10500 MiB but never held the lock; no process killed, no concurrent run, no OOM
queue_and_gpu.smi_outlier: rgbw001 SMI delta 6870 MiB vs 4871-4883 for siblings, while torch peak is identical (3230 MiB); co-tenant fluctuation in the 30 ms sampling window

step_sweep_20261105.invalid_runs: none; all 10 new runs exited 0 and produced mesh.ply and summary.json. One evaluation wrapper call failed on a stray empty argument (unrecognized arguments) and produced no partial artefacts; rerun succeeded and no old cell was overwritten
